mechanism: Cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially reducing chlorthalidone levels; chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion which may increase seizure risk and affect cenobamate efficacy.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, particularly potassium and sodium; ensure adequate seizure control on current cenobamate dose; consider alternative antihypertensive if hypokalemia develops.
